description: Up to 25 Google keywords a domain ranks for, with position, ranking page, search volume, CPC and difficulty (DataForSEO Labs Ranked Keywords). Returns: JSON with target, total_available, keywords. PAID: 0.04 USDC per call (USDC on eip155:8453, x402 v2). Requires an x402-capable MCP client that attaches the payment in _meta["x402/payment"] (e.g. createx402MCPClient from @x402/mcp). Without a payment this tool returns a "payment required" result and charges nothing.

domain.description: Domain to analyze, e.g. example.com. A pasted URL is reduced to its domain; IP addresses and ports are rejected.

language_code.description: Language code such as en or de. Default: English if available for the country, else its first language. Unsupported country/language pairs are refused before payment.

location_code.description: DataForSEO location code. Country level: 2840 = United States (default), 2276 = Germany, 2040 = Austria, 2756 = Switzerland. Google SERP, Maps, News, Images and Local Market Check also accept city/region codes in Germany, Austria and Switzerland (free lookup: GET /api/v1/locations?q=...).

name: ranked_keywords
